name: askwam
help: Silently request a token from Windows WAM
long_help: Runs the x64 askWAM BOF in the current process and user context. All arguments are optional. Boolean switches are int32 values: 0 disables and 1 enables. Scope and resource are mutually exclusive, as are CAE and custom claims.

arguments.name: client-id
arguments.desc: Public client ID; empty uses Teams desktop/mobile

arguments.name: scope
arguments.desc: v2 scope; empty uses Graph .default unless resource is set

arguments.name: resource
arguments.desc: WAM v1-compatible resource; mutually exclusive with scope

arguments.name: claims-json
arguments.desc: Raw OAuth claims object; mutually exclusive with CAE

arguments.name: account-id
arguments.desc: Exact opaque WAM account ID; mutually exclusive with username

arguments.name: username
arguments.desc: Exact unique username; mutually exclusive with account ID

arguments.name: hide
arguments.desc: Set to 1 to omit the access token

arguments.name: cae
arguments.desc: Set to 1 to send predefined cp1 claims

arguments.name: enum
arguments.desc: Set to 1 to enumerate accounts without requesting a token
